limitations.quote: // The final 0 can start another match, even across invalid cycles.
limitations.note: The edit fixed the duplicate state encoding but also reused the final zero after a match, enabling overlapping detections that the original FSM's post-match transitions did not allow.
The testbench's rolling history expected overlapping matches, so it passed the changed behavior instead of checking that the original post-match transitions were preserved.
